name: List All Vendors
description: Returns all vendors that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter vendors updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of Vendor objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].Tags
responseFields.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].TaxpayerId
responseFields.description: The tax identification number of the vendor. This field accepts either a Employer Identification Number (EIN), a Social Security Number (SSN), or an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN).

responseFields.name: data[].TaxpayerName
responseFields.description: The taxpayer name of the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].CompanyName
responseFields.description: The display name of a vendor's company

responseFields.name: data[].IsCompany
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor identifies as a company

responseFields.name: data[].UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not to use the company name as the taxpayer name

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity

responseFields.name: data[].CheckConsolidation
responseFields.description: How to consolidate checks for payment
enum: All bills on single check (hide extra stub detail)

responseFields.name: data[].CheckStubBreakdown
responseFields.description: How to break down the components of a check stub
enum: List each bill detail line item (expanded view)

responseFields.name: data[].HoldPayments
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not to hold payments until the work order is completed

responseFields.name: data[].EmailEcheckReceipt
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not to send a notification to the payee after an eCheck payment is made

responseFields.name: data[].PaymentTerms
responseFields.description: Represents the number of days the payment is due after the invoice date. A null value indicates that no payment terms were defined. A value of 0 indicates the payment is due on receipt. A value greater than 0, for example, 15, indicates the payment is due 15 days after the invoice date.

responseFields.name: data[].UsingEomTerms
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the payment terms include an end-of-month (EOM) stipulation.

responseFields.name: data[].DefaultCheckMemo
responseFields.description: The check memo that will appear when creating a bill for this vendor

responseFields.name: data[].DefaultGlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account that will appear when creating a bill or work order for this vendor

responseFields.name: data[].DoNotUseForWorkOrder
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the vendor is ineligible for work order assignments. When set to true, this vendor should not be considered for new work orders.

responseFields.name: data[].WorkOrderAdjustment
responseFields.description: The percent amount to discount or markup the work order's bill. The work order adjustment is defaulted to zero percent.

responseFields.name: data[].AdjustmentType
responseFields.description: The type of adjustment, discount or markup to apply to the work order. The default value is discount.

responseFields.name: data[].Send1099
responseFields.description: Whether or not the vendor needs a 1099 tax form from the management company

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The vendor's first name

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The vendor's last name

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the vendor is located

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the vendor is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the vendor is located

responseFields.name: data[].CountryCode
responseFields.description: The country code of the vendor (e.g. "JP" for Japan)

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The vendor's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumbers
responseFields.description: The vendor's phone numbers

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The vendor's primary email address

responseFields.name: data[].Emails
responseFields.description: The vendor's emails

responseFields.name: data[].CompanyURL
responseFields.description: The internet address of the vendor's website

responseFields.name: data[].LiabilityInsuranceExpiration
responseFields.description: The expiration date of the vendor's liability insurance

responseFields.name: data[].AutoInsuranceExpiration
responseFields.description: The expiration date of the vendor's automobile insurance

responseFields.name: data[].WorkersCompExpiration
responseFields.description: The expiration date of the vendor's worker's compensation insurance

responseFields.name: data[].ContractExpiration
responseFields.description: The expiration date of the vendor's contract

responseFields.name: data[].UmbrellaInsuranceExpiration
responseFields.description: The expiration date of the vendor's umbrella insurance

responseFields.name: data[].CompliantStatus
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor meets compliance

responseFields.name: data[].NetVendorId
responseFields.description: The vendor's NetVendor ID

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the vendor's page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: When the vendor was marked inactive by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the vendor's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].DefaultAutoAcceptWorkOrders
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the vendor is ineligible for auto-accept work order assignments. When set to true, this vendor will auto-accept all work orders assigned to them.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
